scripts.dev: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && node scripts/dev-host.ts local node --import ./scripts/local-dev.ts apps/local/server/src/dev.ts
scripts.server: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && node scripts/dev-host.ts local node --import ./scripts/local-dev.ts apps/local/server/src/main.ts
scripts.hosted:dev: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && node scripts/dev-host.ts self-host node apps/hosted/self-host/scripts/dev.ts
scripts.hosted:test-server: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && bun run hosted:self-host:web:build && bun apps/hosted/testing/self-host.ts
scripts.hosted:cloud:dev: bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud framework:build && node scripts/dev-host.ts cloud node apps/hosted/cloud/scripts/local-dev.ts
scripts.hosted:cloud:dev:1password: bun run with:cloud:dev bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud dev --stage development
scripts.hosted:cloud:deploy: bun run with:cloud bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud deploy
scripts.hosted:cloud:test-stage: bun run with:test-stage bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud test-stage
scripts.dns:deploy: agent-vault run --env 'CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=op://Agents/Cloudflare API Token/credential' -- env CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=6691acaf4b3f35d16446cce82110a6c5 bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud alchemy deploy alchemy.dns.ts --stage shared
scripts.agent-mail:deploy: bun run with:test-stage env CI=true bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud alchemy deploy alchemy.agent-mail.ts --stage shared
scripts.hosted:docker: bun run with:self-host env BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:4400 EXECUTOR_BUILD_VERSION=$(git rev-parse HEAD) docker compose -f apps/hosted/self-host/compose.yaml up --build -d
scripts.hosted:docker:down: bun run with:self-host docker compose -f apps/hosted/self-host/compose.yaml down
scripts.executor: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && node --import ./scripts/local-dev.ts apps/local/server/src/bin.ts
scripts.hosted:proxy: PORTLESS_PORT=5394 PORTLESS_HTTPS=1 PORTLESS_SHARED_PORT=0 PORTLESS_MULTIPLEX=0 portless proxy start
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && node --import ./scripts/local-dev.ts apps/local/desktop/scripts/start.mjs --dev
scripts.desktop:start: bun run apps:build && bun run telemetry:build && bun run web:build && node --import ./scripts/local-dev.ts apps/local/desktop/scripts/start.mjs
scripts.hosted:cloud:site:build: bun run --parallel marketing:build docs:build hosted:cloud:web:build && node apps/hosted/cloud/scripts/build-site.ts
scripts.check: bun run patches:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run apps:protocols && bun run apps:telemetry && bun run api:errors && bun run auth:rate-limit && node packages/apps/scripts/browser-scripts.mjs --check && node packages/app-templates/scripts/executor-intro.ts --check && node scripts/check-no-unit-tests.ts && node apps/hosted/cloud/scripts/edge-contract.ts --check && node e2e/check-boundary.ts
scripts.e2e:check: node scripts/check-no-unit-tests.ts && node e2e/check-boundary.ts && tsc-rs --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.e2e:viewer:build: bun run --cwd e2e/viewer build:styles && bun build e2e/viewer/main.tsx --target browser --minify --outdir .local/e2e-viewer
scripts.hosted:billing:deploy: op run --env-file=.env.billing.op -- bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud alchemy deploy alchemy.billing.ts
scripts.ci:plan: op run --env-file=.env.ci.op -- bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud alchemy deploy alchemy.github.ts --dry-run --detect-drift --no-input
scripts.ci:deploy: op run --env-file=.env.ci.op -- bun run --cwd apps/hosted/cloud alchemy deploy alchemy.github.ts
scripts.apps:check: bun run apps:build && bun run --cwd packages/apps test:package
